description:
## What

PKIX-fmtv.13 introduces `verify_code_signer` + `verify_time_stamper` + `verify_ocsp_responder` thin wrappers. None of those are DANE-relevant. But there's a parallel question for the eventual SMTP DANE wrapper (RFC 7672) — is there a verify_smtp_dane / verify_smtp_signer / similar that also takes DANE-default-on?

## Why this matters

RFC 7672 SMTP-DANE has the strongest production deployment of any DANE flavor. MTAs negotiating TLS routinely use SMTP-DANE for trust. A workspace adopting DANE-default for HTTPS but not SMTP would be incomplete.

## Options

- **A) Yes, verify_smtp_signer / verify_smtp_dane gains DANE-default-on under same Cargo feature.** SMTP and HTTPS share the resolver + DANE primitives; only the wrapper differs (RFC 7672 SMTP-DANE has slightly different semantics — opportunistic, MX-name-derived TLSA query).

- **B) No, SMTP stays a separate decision.** Maybe in pkix-chain, maybe in a sibling pkix-smtp crate.

- **C) Defer.** Decide when verify_smtp_signer is actually being designed.

## Considerations

- 'Encourage DANE to spread' applies equally (or more) to SMTP.
- SMTP-DANE has known operational subtleties (MX records, DNSSEC down the chain, RFC 7672 §3 query construction) that may warrant its own wrapper / crate.

## Decision-gate

Human-labeled. Probably resolves when verify_smtp_signer work begins.
title: Decide whether verify_smtp_signer (PKIX-fmtv.13) also gets DANE-default-on
